performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but $26/day spend is too thin for August prove-it stakes.

findings.text: CPL fell to $11.25 (28d) and dropped 47.33% week-over-week — efficiency is confirmed, but $26.26/day spend is dangerously low for a prove-it month.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) unresolved: 122 leads logged vs 89 GHL opps and 0 appointments — intake leak hiding true conversion rate.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) unresolved: 0 won opportunities and 0 appointments in GHL signal pipeline data is unreliable for the August scoreboard.
3-day spend signal (Aug 21–23: $22.17, $12.31, $36.22) is erratic and averages $23.57/day — well below the prior 3-day avg of $27.66, confirming a budget compression trend.
IG reach collapsed 54.65% week-over-week, hitting 64–89/day in the last 3 days vs 300+ in mid-August — organic social is no longer supporting paid retargeting audience refresh.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20% (from ~$26/day to ~$31/day) to defend CPL floor while efficiency is confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL confirmed at $11.25 over 28 days with a 47.33% week-over-week drop, but daily spend has compressed to $23.57 avg over the last 3 days — well below the $26.26 weekly avg. Raise Meta daily budget by +20% (target ~$31/day) to prevent lead volume from stalling in the August prove-it window. Success check: CPL stays at or below $15 and leads-per-day hold at 4+ over the next 7 days. Re-evaluate 2026-08-31.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap (overdue Aug 7) — 33 leads unaccounted between Meta (122) and GHL opps (89).
suggestions.monday_update: 122 Meta leads were generated in 28 days, but only 89 GHL opportunities were created and 0 appointments are recorded — a 33-lead gap that breaks the client's scoreboard (leads → schedule → show → patient). The phone-match attribution fix (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) are both overdue. Assign both to Attribution and CRM teams immediately. Success check: GHL opp count matches lead count within 10% and at least 1 appointment appears in pipeline by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Watch IG reach daily; if 3-day avg stays below 100, flag for creative refresh on retargeting audience replenishment.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach dropped 54.65% week-over-week and hit 64–89/day in the last 3 days (vs 300+ in mid-August), which may shrink the retargeting pool feeding the top campaign ($734.23 of 28-day spend). No action yet — one more cycle needed to confirm. If the 3-day average remains below 100 at next check (2026-08-27), escalate to creative refresh. Re-check 2026-08-27.
